result.summary: Found one clear visual/content defect: an untranslated localization key is rendered as a section heading. Carousel edge clipping and bottom viewport cutoff were intentionally not reported per instructions.

issues.description: The section heading shows the raw string "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title such as "Popular near you".
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing localization/resource mapping so the key resolves to translated copy; add a fallback title and QA check for unresolved i18n keys.
